title: DDG Lite 202/403 Failure Causes Source Distribution Skew (100% arXiv / Wikipedia)
description: DDG Lite returns HTTP 202/403 for automated requests. _duckduckgo_search catches this and silently returns []. Because WebSearchTool.search() requires len(combined) < 2 to trigger fallback web/news items, when Wikipedia or arXiv return >= 2 items, fallback web/news sources are skipped, resulting in 100% arXiv/Wikipedia results without live web/news data.
empirical_log: Returned 2 results: 0 web/news, 0 wikipedia, 2 arxiv. URLs: ['http://arxiv.org/abs/1304.1836v2', 'http://arxiv.org/abs/1005.0280v6']

title: Configuration Key Name Mismatch Between config.py and web_search.py
description: config.py defines google_search_api_key and google_search_engine_id, but WebSearchTool reads GEMINI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CX directly from os.environ.
repro_steps: Inspect web_search.py __init__ vs app/config.py Settings fields.
empirical_log: config.py defines google_search_api_key and google_search_engine_id, but WebSearchTool reads GEMINI_API_KEY and GOOGLE_CX directly from os.environ.

title: MockProvider.generate_structured() Crashes on Pydantic Models with List Fields
description: MockProvider.generate_structured checks `f.annotation == list` which evaluates to False for typing origins like `list[AlternativeOption]` or `List[str]`. Consequently, required list fields are assigned `None`, triggering a Pydantic ValidationError.

title: graph.py synthesis_node Crashes on Single Alternative LLM Output (IndexError / KeyError)
description: In graph.py synthesis_node, lines 683-684 hardcode references to `alternatives[0]` and `alternatives[1]`. If the LLM generates a JSON code block with 1 alternative option, or uses alternate key names (e.g. `title` instead of `name`), the node crashes with an unhandled IndexError or KeyError.
repro_steps: Pass an LLM response containing a single JSON alternative to synthesis_node.
empirical_log: IndexError: list index out of range

title: Leftover Hardcoded Domain Templates ('React', 'Next.js') in synthesis.py
description: synthesis.py contains hardcoded conditional branches injecting 'React Component Architecture Strategy', 'Full-Stack React & Next.js Ecosystem Path', and 'React + TypeScript Enterprise Standard Path' whenever the objective or claims mention 'react', regardless of actual decision context.
empirical_log: Found 'Core React Component Architecture Strategy' and 'Full-Stack React & Next.js Ecosystem Path' hardcoded in synthesis.py

title: Stubbed Nodes in graph.py (Retrieval Node Mocking, Fact Check Hardcoding, Blank Contradiction Node)
description: graph.py contains dummy hardcoded implementations: retrieval_node returns static mock chunk 'doc-internal-ref-001' without querying Qdrant RAG store; fact_check_node marks all claims as verified: True with 0.95 confidence without verification; contradiction_node always sets contradictions = [].
repro_steps: Inspect app/agents/graph.py retrieval_node, fact_check_node, and contradiction_node.
empirical_log: Found hardcoded mock chunk 'doc-internal-ref-001' in retrieval_node and static verified=True in fact_check_node.

title: Prompt Injection Vulnerability in graph.py synthesis_node via Unsanitized External Web Snippets
description: In graph.py synthesis_node (lines 578-612), raw external web search snippets are directly formatted into the LLM prompt (`{snippets_text}`) without XML boundary delimiters (e.g. `<retrieved_snippets>`), escaping, or prompt injection sanitization. Adversarial web content can manipulate the LLM into disregarding instructions or outputting unauthorized text.
repro_steps: Retrieve web content containing prompt injection instructions and pass to synthesis_node.
empirical_log: Unsanitized string interpolation of snippet text directly into LLM system prompt.
